name: duration-event-counts
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Events", COUNTROWS(events), "Evaluated", COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(events, events[evaluated] = TRUE())), 0), "Forest flags", COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(events, events[iforest_flag] = TRUE())), 0), "Robust flags", COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(events, events[robust_flag] = TRUE())), 0) )

name: empty-context-has-zero-flags
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "Forest flags", COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(events, events[iforest_flag] = TRUE())), 0), "Robust flags", COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(events, events[robust_flag] = TRUE())), 0) ), FILTER(events, FALSE()) )

name: cycle-iforest
